adjudication_notes: Table II supports the bounded cross-domain performance claim.
Table V supports a heterogeneous IPA contribution, not a universal gain.
The causal-intervention claim is marked insufficient because diagrams, equations, and predictive ablations do not identify removal of real confounding.
The KL-term claim remains partial because it is tested once without uncertainty.
